articles.image_title: TOPSHOT - People stand close to a stranded humpback whale in the Wismarer Bucht bay of the Baltic Sea off the island of Poel, northern Germany, on April 27, 2026. A private rescue attempt for the whale still goes on. The 13.5-metre (44-foot) humpback whale's ordeal first began in late March 2026 when it was spotted stuck on a sandbank near the city of Luebeck. It first freed itself only to become stuck again further east along the German coast. Earlier in April 2026 officials said they expected the animal to die, saying it had been too weakened by the odyssey to survive and make its way back to its natural habitat in the Atlantic. Coverage of the whale's struggle for survival and efforts to rescue it have gripped the German public, with some of the press calling the animal "Timmy". (Photo by Danny Gohlke / AFP)

articles.image_title: June 29, 2017 - Munich - Anti-racism and anti-discrimination activist and member of the migrationsbeirat Hamado Dipama. 15 citizens and members of the Netzwerk Rassismus- und Diskriminierungsfrei Bayern eV demonstrated at MunichÃ¢â¬â¢s Hauptbahnhof against the latest case of misconduct by Deutsche Bahn Security, which was filmed by a journalist on an S8 S-Bahn train. Journalist Natalija Miletic filmed the incident and is heard saying Ã¢â¬ÅracismÃ¢â¬Â, alleging that the processes the personnel used created an escalation and were violations of their policies and went into areas only the police are allowed to handle...In the latest case of a string of verbal and physical abuse allegations, as well as racial profiling and insults against Deutsche Bahn security personnel, a violent escalation was filmed and posted by journalist Natalija Miletic, where racism and irregularities in the fine processing were alleged and a dangerous chokehold was instituted against a Nigerian passenger, well past the time limit before brain injury occurs. Deutsche Bahn has condemned the escalation of violence, while critics claim this to be part of the working culture of security employees. The case is under investigation by the Bundespolizei against the Deutsche Bahn employees, as well as the victim. ..The victim had no ticket, as verified by the Deutsche Bahn security personnel, but, according to the account, they made the process difficult, including having confiscated the last 9 Euros the man had and then imposing the fine of 60 EUR. It is unknown if they documented the confiscation. ..Heavy, ongoing criticism is being thrown at Deutsche Bahn's inconsistently-applied policies of removing so-called ''Schwarzfahrer'' from trains, as they increase the risk of escalations...

articles.title: „Ich stehe hinter ihr“ – Fabians Vater und die Angeklagte sind wieder ein Paar
articles.teaser: Sie soll seinen achtjährigen Sohn getötet haben – trotzdem steht er hinter ihr. Am dritten Prozesstag im Mordfall Fabian gibt Matthias R. zu: Er und die Angeklagte Gina H. sind wieder ein Paar. Das Gericht präsentiert unterdessen verstörende Details aus ihren Google-Suchen.
articles.image_title: 05.05.2026, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Rostock: Die Angeklagte wartet im Saal des Landgerichts auf die Fortsetzung des Verfahrens wegen Mordes. Der Angeklagten wird vorgeworfen, am 10.10.2025 heimtückisch und aus sonst niedrigen Beweggründen den zur Tatzeit 8-jährigen Fabian aus Güstrow getötet zu haben.
